reddit.title: Improved Music Transitions in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to the way music transitions in Provincia. The day, night, title, and combat beds now feature a smooth crossfade instead of a hard cut, enhancing your gaming experience. Check out the details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops
